user.title: Connect Notion
user.description: How do you want to sign in to Notion?

menu_options.token: Token (personal access token or internal integration)

token.title: Notion token
token.description: Create a personal access token at notion.so/developers/tokens. It gives Home Assistant the same access as you, so you can pick any page or database in the next steps. An internal integration secret also works, but then only pages shared with that integration are listed.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to Notion again
reauth_confirm.description: The Notion token stopped working (personal access tokens expire). Paste a new token for the same workspace.

reauth_oauth.title: Sign in to Notion again
reauth_oauth.description: Notion rejected the saved login. Sign in with Notion again.

databases.title: Databases
databases.description: Found {count} databases. Pick the ones to show in Home Assistant. Each becomes a todo list and/or a table sensor. You can add more later.

pages.title: Pages
pages.description: Showing {count} pages (search: {query}). Pick pages to show as markdown and sensors. Type a search term and submit to find more, including database rows.

data_description.pages: Selections are kept when you search.
data_description.search: Submit with a search term to list matching pages, or leave empty to continue.

data_description.view_id: Use the filter and sort order of a view (for example "My tasks"). Leave empty for all rows.
data_description.columns: Shown under each todo item and in the table sensor.

todo.name: Todo list
todo.description: Two-way sync: checking an item in Home Assistant updates Notion.

data_description.todo_enabled: Needs a status or checkbox property.
data_description.done_property: Status or checkbox property that marks an item as done.
data_description.done_values: For a status property: options that count as done.
data_description.open_value: For a status property: option set when an item is un-checked.
data_description.description_property: Optional text property, editable from Home Assistant.
data_description.assignee_property: Optional people property set to you on new items, so they show up in views filtered on you.
data_description.completed_days: Done items edited longer ago than this are hidden. 0 hides them right away.

data_description.show_markdown: Adds a sensor with the page content in the markdown attribute.
data_description.properties: Each selected property becomes a sensor (checkboxes become binary sensors).
data_description.scan_interval: How often the page is checked for changes. Content is only downloaded when it changed.

error.invalid_auth: Notion did not accept the token.
error.done_property_required: Pick a done property, or turn off the todo list.
error.done_values_required: Pick at least one value that means done.

abort.already_configured: This Notion workspace is already set up.
abort.wrong_account: That token belongs to another Notion workspace.
abort.missing_configuration: OAuth is not configured. Add Notion application credentials first.

data_description.debug: Logs every Notion API call, sync differences and writes to the Home Assistant log.
